name: Scroll Network token unchecked router transfer underflow
summary: SCROLL's transfer(address,uint256) blocks ordinary holder-to-holder transfers with a bare "Err" revert but exempts the Uniswap UniversalRouter, and on that exempt path it debits the sender without any balance-sufficiency check. Because UniversalRouter.execute is permissionless and its TRANSFER command (0x05) moves the router's own token balance, the attacker made the zero-balance router send 1 wei of SCROLL, underflowing the router's SCROLL balance to 2^256-1, then routed 136,275,915 SCROLL from that fabricated balance into the SCROLL/WETH Uniswap V2 pair and swapped it out for the pair's entire WETH reserve.

loss.notes: Exact victim depletion: the Uniswap V2 pair 0xa718aa1b3f61c2b90a01ab244597816a7ee69fd2 transferred 76.360109345510532175 WETH out in the single Swap of the anchor transaction, leaving a 0.076589 WETH reserve. The attacker unwrapped that WETH and forwarded 76.361109345510532175 ETH to the sender EOA, the extra 999999 wei being the value the sender supplied with the deployment; only the pair's WETH is victim loss. WETH is valued at the DefiLlama WETH price seven seconds before the exploit block; the attacker's own SCROLL selling moved only the SCROLL leg, which is worthless fabricated supply and is not counted. Six later transactions by five unrelated senders reproduced the same underflow between blocks 19973774 and 19989190, but the pair was already empty and they removed 0.0406 WETH in total, so they are copycat follow-ons rather than part of this campaign and are not included.

lastCodeChange.description: The 11,337-byte SCROLL runtime was installed by top-level CREATE in this transaction and is byte-identical at block 19956149 and at block 19971610, the block before the exploit.

sources.note: Reviewed the anchor receipt and full call trace, the token's complete Transfer log history, the deployment receipt, historical runtime bytecode, and a mainnet fork reproduction at block 19971610. The anchor 0x661505c3... is a contract creation at 19971611:4 whose constructor performs the attack; status 1. Its trace calls SCROLL 0xe51d3de9b81916d383ef97855c271250852ec7b7 directly in 13 frames (no DELEGATECALL), so the defect-bearing runtime is the token itself and not the UniversalRouter, the pair, or the router library. Root cause reproduced on a fork of block 19971610: an arbitrary zero-balance EOA calling transfer(randomAddress, 1) reverts with "Err", while the same call from the Uniswap UniversalRouter 0x3fc91a3afd70395cd496c647d5a6cc9d4b2b7fad succeeds and leaves the router's balanceOf at 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 = 2^256-1, proving the exempt path subtracts the sender's balance with no sufficiency check. In the anchor the attacker uses UniversalRouter.execute(0x24856bc3) with command 0x05 three times: 1 wei to owner 0x72c509b0... (log 37), 136,275,915.391323680414683 SCROLL to the pair 0xa718aa1b3f61c2b90a01ab244597816a7ee69fd2 (log 38), and the residual 2^256-1 minus that amount to the exploit contract (log 43); the pair's Swap (log 41) returns 76.360109345510532175 WETH. Anchor minimality: scanning every Transfer log of the token from its deployment block 19956149 to the present shows this transaction is the first with a value above the 1e27 total supply, i.e. the first underflow; the six later underflow transactions come from five different senders after the pair was drained and take 0.0406 WETH in total. Code history: the token was created by top-level CREATE in 0xca4c50dc... at 19956149:7 by 0x72c509b05a44c4bb53373efc2e76fb75fa8108a6, an address distinct from the exploit sender 0x55db954f0121e09ec838a20c216eabf35ca32cdd; keccak of the runtime is 0x4d5a9119af62ea7854842f78b3951fed458c5945aeb8319a588a091a5f2543c3 at both block 19956149 and block 19971610, the contract is not a proxy and emitted no upgrade events, so lastCodeChange is the deployment and the code was 186,684 s (2.16 days) old.

legacy migration note retained for provenance: onchain review: SCROLL 'Scroll Network' 0xe51D3dE9b81916D383eF97855C271250852eC7B7 created 2024-05-26T19:30:11Z by 0x72c509b05a44c4bb53373efc2e76fb75fa8108a6, not the attack-tx sender 0x55db954f0121e09ec838a20c216eabf35ca32cdd; no EIP-1967 events, unverified source, so age runs from deployment (2.16 days). Verified at block 19971610 that UniversalRouter 0x3fC91A3afd70395Cd496C647d5a6CC9D4B2b7FAD held 0 SCROLL and the WETH pair held 1.363e23, confirming the router's balance was created by the exploit's first TRANSFER rather than pre-existing. The legacy 292,583 USD figure rounded the drain to 76 ETH; this review replaces it with the exact 76.360109345510532175 WETH depletion.

limitations: The SCROLL token source is not verified on Etherscan; the root cause was established from the anchor call trace, the token's Transfer log history, and a mainnet-fork reproduction rather than from published source.
